title: M700 Vesta Vault Recovery

forensic_metrics.financial: $24 per unit savings on chassis costs via hard tooling transition
forensic_metrics.process: Analyzed 3,000,000+ disc injection cycles to isolate 10% failure threshold
forensic_metrics.governance: Weekly Reliability Investigation / High-touch 'Run-In' test cycle

forensic_summary.trigger: Catastrophic field failures (disc jams, scratching, 'unreadable' media) due to tolerance drift
forensic_summary.intervention: Complete mechanical subsystem redesign: Dual radial spring balance bars, solid motor mounts, and disc guide retrofit
forensic_summary.result: Eliminated 100% of 'dirty roller' slippage failures and recovered 100% of questioned carousel inventory

war_stories.label: The Potato Chip Carousel
war_stories.description: Identified 'potato chipped' warping in 200-series carousel slots; developed inspection criteria to validate inventory rather than scrap it

war_stories.label: The Dirty Roller Friction Drop
war_stories.description: Discovered coated rollers had high initial grip but failed rapidly with dust; reverted to mechanical force solution (stronger springs) over surface friction

war_stories.label: The Vanishing Disc
war_stories.description: Root caused 'Disc vanished into thin air' log errors to sensor misalignment and 'wringing' effect between static-charged discs

isomorphics.label: Friction vs. Force
isomorphics.hardware_point: Surface coatings (chemical friction) failed under environmental stress (dust); Mechanical force (springs/geometry) proved robust
isomorphics.software_point: Firmware retry logic vs. physical sensor state truth
isomorphics.principle: Mechanical determinism supercedes material coefficient reliance in dirty environments.

bom.label: Roller Shaft
bom.value: Reinforced/Thicker Shaft with Pillow Block Extension

events.snippet: First 50 HDD assemblies built with spring 501-1127-00 installed incorrectly.
Sanmina reports DVD/Fan brackets do not sit flat on chassis.
Carousel T1 results: Massive flash from intentional over-pressure to fill tool.
Short shot detected on carousel due to air trap.
Roller slot contamination observed on SN 885. Rework instructions issued.
SN 445 fails run-in. Disc sticking out. Roller testing initiated.
Defective front slot pinch roller transferred to Engineering for autopsy.
Testing SN 3150 with SN 804 rollers. Fibers found on rollers.
Root Cause: Front inner guide confirmed scratching discs. Video evidence.
Escalation 126532: M700 continually jamming. Customer requesting replacement.
Logistics: 7 RMA units arrived in Sunnyvale for forensic teardown.
Escalation 129483: Roller spring visibly deformed/angled high in field unit.
Sensor board failure traced to bad solder joint at R22 (Sanmina process).
SN 2820 fails run-in. ODD possibly damaged by double-disc insert.
Datalogger analysis: Units subjected to 41G shock during handling.
Missing E-clip identified as root cause for field return SN 0600000030287.
Case 129750: Dealer inserted 6 discs backwards. System eventually rejected.
Service testing Region 2 units with Region 2 discs to reduce false NTF.
Escalation: Disc already present in drive. Vault failing errors 78 & 97.
Run-in failure mode: Rollers pushing disc too far out front slot.
Hardware Meeting: Pivot to stronger springs, solid motor mounts, extended gear.
Quote requested for prototype springs 330-1050-02/03/04.
Sunnyvale stock audit reveals warped carousels. Packaging suspect.
Diagnosis confirmed: Dirty rollers cause friction drop and disc slippage.
Vendor RubberTek contacted regarding poor dirt resistance of roller material.
RubberTek responds: 'Inevitable for most rubber... to get dirt'.
Double strength springs and modified inner guide pass validation.
JIRA ESCALATION-588 Closed. Jamming issue tracked to dispersion.
Proposal to ship vaults without rack ears to prevent foam cutting.
RMA 48932: Confirmed scratching on front disc guide.
Outer disc guide identified as sole point of scratching due to left shift.
Tinnerman clips found damaged by vendor (Demsa). Front panel retention compromised.
Severe quality issue: 502-1192-00 rejected at Sanmina for scratches/dings.
Stronger spring changes rolled into production to fix stuck discs.
